display_name: Support Agent — Escalation vs RAG Resolution

workflow.name: support-agent-comparison
workflow.description: Compare two customer support agent strategies: an escalation-first approach that quickly routes to human agents vs a RAG-powered resolution strategy that attempts automated resolution using knowledge base retrieval and sub-agent delegation. Showcases nested tool calls, sub-agent patterns, and the efficiency vs resolution quality tradeoff.

eval_run.name: Escalation-First vs RAG Resolution — Customer Support
eval_run.description: The escalation strategy minimizes AI handling time but increases human agent load. The RAG resolution strategy uses more tool calls and sub-agents but resolves tickets without escalation. Demonstrates how higher upfront cost can reduce total cost of resolution.
